description:
Advanced Space | Full-time | Hybrid 

 We’re going to the Moon. Think you’ve got what it takes?   

  

 About the Role   

 At Advanced Space, we're enabling humanity's return to the Moon and building the technologies that will take us to Mars and beyond. We're looking for a Software Engineer with 5–8 years of experience to develop mission-critical ground and flight software that powers some of the most ambitious space missions in the industry.

 In this role, you'll design, develop, and maintain software supporting spacecraft operations, mission control systems, and advanced space technologies. You'll collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to build reliable, scalable software that supports real missions—from lunar exploration to national security and commercial space programs.

 We're looking for someone who enjoys solving challenging technical problems, writing high-quality software, mentoring teammates, and building systems that help shape the future of space exploration.

 This position is open to U.S. Citizens only. Visa sponsorship is not available. 

 An active security clearance is preferred, or the ability to obtain a TS/SCI clearance is required. 

   

 About Advanced Space   

 Advanced Space exists to enable the sustainable exploration, development, and settlement of space through innovative software, mission services, and technology solutions. As the owner and operator of NASA's CAPSTONE™ mission and the Prime Contractor for AFRL's Oracle mission, we're helping shape the future of cislunar exploration while supporting commercial, civil, and national security customers.   

 Our team combines deep technical expertise with an entrepreneurial mindset. We move quickly, collaborate across disciplines, and empower every engineer to make meaningful contributions. If you're passionate about solving challenging problems and seeing your work fly in space, you'll fit right in.   

   

 What You'll Actually Do   

 Build mission-critical software. 

 Design, develop, test, and maintain ground and flight software that supports spacecraft operations, mission control, and next-generation space missions. Contribute across the full software development lifecycle—from new features to bug fixes and system enhancements.

 Design scalable software solutions. 

 Translate system requirements into clean, maintainable code while contributing to software architecture, design decisions, and reusable engineering solutions. Help improve system performance, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

 Collaborate across engineering teams. 

 Partner with systems engineers, mission designers, navigation engineers, and software teammates to develop integrated solutions that support real spacecraft missions. Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, and technical discussions.

 Improve engineering processes. 

 Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, containerized development environments, software lifecycle improvements, and engineering best practices. Help identify opportunities to improve development efficiency and software quality.

 Mentor and grow. 

 Support junior engineers through technical mentoring, code reviews, and knowledge sharing while continuing to expand your own expertise in spacecraft software, modern development practices, and emerging technologies.

   

 Who Thrives Here   

 
 You have 5–8 years of experience developing software for spacecraft systems, mission control systems, or other complex engineering applications.

 You have strong experience developing software using C++, Python, or other modern programming languages .

 You have experience contributing to software architecture and translating system requirements into well-designed software solutions.

 You're familiar with software development best practices, design patterns, version control, and code reuse strategies.

 You have experience with CI/CD pipelines and understand modern software delivery practices.

 You're familiar with container technologies such as Kubernetes or Docker.

 You enjoy collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams and contributing to complex technical discussions.

 You have experience mentoring junior engineers and helping elevate software quality across a team.

 You take ownership. When you see a challenge, you work with the team to solve it.

 
  

 Bonus Points if You Have Experience With 

 
 Flight software or spacecraft mission control systems

 Spacecraft autonomy or distributed systems

 Kubernetes, Docker, or containerized deployments

 CI/CD automation and DevOps practices

 Systems architecture and software design for aerospace applications

 Agile software development and technical leadership

 National security or classified software development environments

 An active TS/SCI security clearance

 
  

 Success is Measured By   

 
 Delivering reliable, maintainable software that supports mission success.

 Building scalable software architectures that enable future growth.

 Contributing to successful spacecraft missions through high-quality engineering.

 Improving software development processes, automation, and engineering efficiency.

 Mentoring teammates and strengthening the technical capabilities of the software team.

 Collaborating effectively across engineering disciplines to solve complex mission challenges.

 
  

 Why Join Advanced Space   

 
 Build software that powers real missions to the Moon and beyond.

 Work alongside world-class engineers developing cutting-edge aerospace technologies.

 Help shape the future of spacecraft software, autonomy, and mission operations.

 Be part of a growing company where your contributions directly impact mission success.

 Join a team that's passionate about delivering innovation to orbit—and beyond.

 
  

 Compensation & Benefits   

 
 Base Salary: $114,000–$149,000 (based on experience, qualifications, and location)

 Signing bonus

 Quarterly performance bonuses

 Company-sponsored medical benefits and 401(k)

 Flexible time off

 Relocation assistance 

 
  

 Advanced Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
